summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Bartholomew Mosse, an Irish surgeon and impresario. Its single main point is that he founded the Rotunda Hospital in Dublin. It gives his lifespan as 1712 to 16 February 1759.
one_line: Bartholomew Mosse was an 18th-century Irish surgeon and impresario who founded Dublin's Rotunda Hospital.
key_facts: Bartholomew Mosse lived from 1712 to 16 February 1759.
Bartholomew Mosse was an Irish surgeon.
Bartholomew Mosse was responsible for founding the Rotunda Hospital in Dublin.
